security_audit.summary: All 76 static detections are false positives involving Markdown, documentation links, illustrative URLs, protected token storage, or model-selection prose. One semantic concern remains: inline shell examples lack safe quoting guidance despite claiming prompt content cannot cause injection. No evidence found of malicious instructions, credential exfiltration, or security-review manipulation; external CLI behavior was not independently verified.

remediation.issue: Shell examples wrap editable JSON in single quotes, but the input-boundary guidance incorrectly dismisses shell injection.
remediation.suggestion: Pass serialized JSON as a separate process argument without a shell, or document safe shell escaping and test apostrophes and shell metacharacters.

semantic_findings.title: Shell-Safety Claim Omits User-Text Quoting Risks
semantic_findings.description: The guidance claims "No shell-injection surface from prompt content" while examples embed editable JSON inside shell single quotes. Inserting unescaped user lyrics or prompts containing apostrophes can break quoting and allow shell commands before the CLI receives JSON.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The examples and unconditional safety claim directly show the missing shell-boundary protection. Exploitation depends on unsafe user-text substitution; no vulnerable runtime implementation is included.

content.user_title: Generate and Edit Music with RunComfy
content.value_statement: Music projects need different models for polished vocals, affordable drafts, and targeted audio edits. This skill selects RunComfy routes and supplies model-specific prompts and command templates.
actual_capabilities: Select ElevenLabs Music, ACE Step, or ACE Step 1.5 based on quality, budget, language, and editing requirements.
Prepare ElevenLabs prompts combining style descriptions, lyrics, section markers, and track duration.
Prepare ACE Step inputs with separate style tags, lyrics, and instrumental markers.
Provide audio-inpaint command templates for replacing a specified time range in existing audio.
Provide audio-outpaint command templates for adding an introduction, an ending, or both.
Document CLI authentication, output-directory selection, common exit codes, and links to further model documentation.
limitations: Requires an external RunComfy CLI, authentication, network access, and paid model usage; no local music engine is included.
Documents time-range audio repair, not mask-based editing; the stated outpaint limit is four minutes total.
Prices, model availability, and claimed CLI protections are not independently verified by this documentation-only skill.
Does not verify lyric rights, guarantee commercial clearance, or ensure seamless loops and exact musical fidelity.

use_cases.title: Repair or Extend Existing Tracks
use_cases.description: Choose time-range inpainting for a weak chorus or outpainting to add an introduction and ending.

prompt_templates.title: Choose a Music Model
prompt_templates.prompt: Recommend a RunComfy model for a 30-second instrumental with piano and soft drums. Prioritize cost and explain the choice without running commands.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a Vocal Jingle
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare a 15-second upbeat ElevenLabs jingle with original lyrics for [brand]. Include section markers and estimate cost before requesting execution approval.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Multilingual Variations
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan three 60-second ACE Step 1.5 vocal tracks in [languages] using consistent style tags and my original lyrics. Estimate total cost before execution.

prompt_templates.title: Repair and Extend a Track
prompt_templates.prompt: Using my audio at [user-provided URL], plan replacement of seconds 20 through 40, then add a 15-second intro and 30-second outro. Preserve the style. Explain safe input handling and request approval before paid calls.

output_examples.input: Recommend a low-cost route for a 60-second instrumental prototype.
output: Suggested route: ACE Step base text-to-audio.
Style brief: mellow piano, soft drums, steady tempo, and instrumental arrangement.
Estimated model cost: $0.012 using the rate listed in the skill; confirm current pricing before execution.
This is a proposed configuration, not a generated audio file.

output_examples.input: Plan a repair for seconds 20 through 40 of my track, followed by a 30-second outro.
output: First route: ACE Step audio-inpaint with start time 20 seconds and end time 40 seconds.
Match the replacement tags to the surrounding arrangement.
Second route: ACE Step audio-outpaint using the repaired track and a 30-second extension after it.
Confirm source-audio access, total duration, and cost before either request.
These are editing recommendations; no audio has been processed.

best_practices: Confirm current model pricing and total duration, then approve a short draft before longer renders or batches.
Use original or licensed lyrics and provide only audio URLs authorized for the current task.
Pass serialized inputs without shell interpolation and keep authentication tokens outside prompts, logs, and version control.
anti_patterns: Insert raw lyrics, prompts, or URLs directly into shell-quoted command templates.
Treat model license descriptions or commercial-friendly wording as guaranteed clearance for generated music.
Run large premium batches before reviewing a short draft and confirming the spending limit.

faq.question: What does this skill provide?
faq.answer: It provides model-selection guidance, prompting patterns, and RunComfy command templates for music generation, section repair, and track extension.

faq.question: Does it generate music locally?
faq.answer: No. Audio generation uses external RunComfy services through an authenticated CLI and requires network access.

faq.question: Which model should I choose?
faq.answer: The guide favors ElevenLabs for polished vocals, ACE Step base for affordable drafts, and ACE Step 1.5 for multilingual vocals.

faq.question: Can it edit an existing song?
faq.answer: It documents ACE Step time-range inpainting and track extension from source-audio URLs. It does not provide mask-based audio editing.

faq.question: Are costs and commercial rights guaranteed?
faq.answer: No. Confirm current service pricing and applicable terms. The skill does not verify ownership or licensing of supplied lyrics and audio.

faq.question: Are the command examples safe to customize directly?
faq.answer: Do not insert unescaped user text into shell commands. Use serialized process arguments, protect tokens, and approve external submissions before execution.
